You can say that about any state really, but, with Alaska, is just hits so much harder. With stunning mountains, endless coastlines, fiery volcanoes, and frequent earthquakes, the state boasts a geography that is truly unique amongst the United States and the world. In this video, I'll share 15 amazing facts about Alaska, from North America's tallest peak, to its millions of lakes and countless glaciers. You'll also discover its unique Arctic climate, isolated capital city, and Wrangell–St. Elias, America’s largest national park. We might even catch a glimpse of nearby Russia!
